name: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

stats.notes: Fall 2025 first-time first-year cohort, CDS C1 residency table (in-state / out-of-state / nonresident: 18,398 / 8,106 / 714 applied; 15,202 / 5,419 / 549 admitted; 4,305 / 497 / 132 enrolled). Only 16% of enrollees submitted SAT and 27% ACT, so the score percentiles describe part of the class. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11. Undergraduate enrollment is the B1 total undergraduates (13,380 men + 12,833 women); intl_undergrads is the B2 nonresident total undergraduates (700). Early action exists (C22, closes Nov 1); no early decision and no waitlist.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A: SAT or ACT 'required for some' (students with a weighted high school GPA below 2.80 must submit a score). Admissions site: for fall 2027 applicants tests are optional with a weighted GPA of 2.8 or higher at the end of junior year.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (2025-26, first-year): in-state tuition $3,812, out-of-state/nonresident $20,018, required fees $3,505, on-campus housing $7,310 + food $5,080 = $12,390. The tuition_usd field is the in-state figure. The 2025-26 CDS has no nonresident-specific financial aid counts, so those fields are left empty.
